# Trajecta ecCodes Rust binding patches

This directory vendors the crates.io package `eccodes` version `0.13.4` from
<https://github.com/ScaleWeather/eccodes>. The upstream crate is licensed under
Apache-2.0; its unmodified `LICENSE` file is retained in this directory. The
published `0.13.4` crate contains no `NOTICE` file.

Trajecta carries a narrow Windows compatibility patch because the upstream
release assumes Unix file APIs and 64-bit C `long`. The modified files are:

- `src/codes_handle/mod.rs`: use an owned `FILE*`, `fopen` for files, and a
  temporary C stream for in-memory messages on Windows;
- `src/intermediate_bindings/codes_get.rs`: marshal ecCodes `long` values via
  `libc::c_long`;
- `src/intermediate_bindings/codes_set.rs`: marshal scalar and array writes via
  `libc::c_long`;
- `src/intermediate_bindings/codes_handle.rs`, `codes_keys.rs`, and
  `grib_nearest.rs`: use the target ABI widths generated by `eccodes-sys`.
- `src/codes_handle/mod.rs` and `src/lib.rs`: expose a safe, idempotent switch
  for ecCodes multi-field GRIB iteration so callers can enumerate every logical
  field inside one physical message.

The multi-field switch is a narrow safe wrapper over the public ecCodes C API.
Keep this file and the modification notices when updating or redistributing the
vendored crate.
